items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: he said, well, Trump had said, wow, just like that.

ctx.x: of course, they didn't want to give me the credit. I didn't want it, no, huh? Because all I was trying to do, take the ideas, you know, to get ahead of the other fella. I went to the, this must have been back in 1910 or 11, but way back then, got a coconut shell and cut it in half. Because you see, I've seen Buddy Petit, but the first one played, you know, with his derby. He was the first man ever played with a derby, you see, and him and another fella, Frederick Kepage, you all heard talking about Frederick…
